gaps.explanation: p6-7 governmental funds statement prints Transfers in 108,667 (General 100,000 + Street 8,667). detail[] has the General Fund Departments combining schedule (pp19-20), which prints transfers between General Fund departments gross: Administrative 100,000, Police 66,000, Fire 100,481, Ambulance 32,500, Recreation 149,250, Museum 26,500, Library 102,917, Cemetery 13,000 = 590,648, plus Street 8,667 (p15) = 599,315. 590,648 - 100,000 = 490,648 are department-to-department transfers inside the General Fund (matched by the 490,648 extra transfers out); as printed, no fix.

p6 General Fund Transfers out (8,667). The departments schedule (p19) prints Administrative (472,997), Fire (11,308), Ambulance (15,010) = (499,315); 499,315 - 8,667 = 490,648 = the intra-General Fund department transfers that also appear as transfers in. Both sides gross by department, net 0; no fix.

No proprietary schedule; p10-11 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Trash Fund columns (Internal Service Fund column excluded). JSON receipts = Sales + Other revenue + Interest income + City sales tax. Electric 3,686,462+12,451+9,152 = 3,708,065; Water 321,926+14,650+1,158+40,521 = 378,255; Sewer 306,150+18+292 = 306,460; Trash 200,017+1,873+76 = 201,966; total 4,594,746 = statement 4,594,746.
